basic_details.job_title: DNH & DD Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 5 Radiologist, Gynecologist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Applications for the Health Department Diu walk-in interview must be sent by 23 November 2026 to [email protected] or by post to Office of Health Officer, CHC Ghoghla-Diu 362540. The interview date will be communicated to eligible candidates. The interview will be held at NAMO Hospital Daman, Nani Daman or Seva Bhavan/ Collectorate, Diu, as the candidate opts. The Office of the Health Officer, Ghoghla, Diu, under the UT Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli & Daman & Diu, is filling 5 posts on short term contract under the UT Plan: 1 Radiologist, 2 Obstetrician & Gynecologist and 2 Anesthetis

age_limit.details: The age limit is 45 years for all three posts. The notice does not print a date on which age is counted. Age relaxation may be considered for Specialists by the Competent authority.

qualification.details: For all three posts, the candidate must possess Graduate/ Master/ PG Degree/ PG Diploma & Valid Registration compulsory. Candidates having a domicile certificate of U.T. of DNH, Daman & Diu will be given preference. Age relaxation may be considered for Specialists by the Competent authority. | The remuneration for all three posts is "up to Rs. 2,00,000/- negotiable based on education qualification (PG Diploma/ Degree) in terms of incentive basis." how_to_apply: Prepare a copy of your bio-data.
Attach self attested copies of your Graduation and Post Graduation Degree and your registration certificates.
Send the application by email to [email protected], or by post to Office of Health Officer, CHC Ghoghla-Diu 362540.
Make sure the application is sent by 23 November 2026, the date till which applications have been invited.
Wait for the interview date, which will be communicated to eligible candidates, and choose to attend the interview either at Daman or at Diu.
important_instructions: All posts are purely on contract basis for the period of 6 months under the UT Plan. In case of continuation, the contract will be extended based on performance appraisal or till the posts are filled up on a regular basis. The specialists need to be available on call as and when required for smooth functioning of the Health Department. Residence in headquarters is compulsory in public interest; the specialists can leave the headquarters only after due approval of the respective Head of Office. An undertaking has to be given that he/she will not do any private practice. For queries, the office telephone number printed on the notice is 02875-252244.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: For all three posts, the candidate must possess Graduate/ Master/ PG Degree/ PG Diploma & Valid Registration compulsory. Candidates having a domicile certificate of U.T. of DNH, Daman & Diu will be given preference. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. The age limit is 45 years for all three posts. The notice does not print a date on which age is counted. Age relaxation may be considered for Specialists by the Competent authority. The remuneration for all three posts is "up to Rs. 2,00,000/- negotiable based on education qualification (PG Diploma/ Degree) in terms of incentive basis." The notice adds that the remuneration is negotiable. It does not mention any separate allowance.

No T.A / D.A or any other claim shall be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Health Department Diu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications have been invited till 23 November 2026, by email to [email protected] or by post to Office of Health Officer, CHC Ghoghla-Diu 362540.

faq.question: Q2. When is the Health Department Diu walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview date will be communicated to the eligible candidates; the notice does not print it.

faq.question: Q3. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: It will be held either at NAMO Hospital Daman, Nani Daman or at Seva Bhavan/ Collectorate, Diu, and candidates may opt for Daman or Diu.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 5 posts: 1 Radiologist, 2 Obstetrician & Gynecologist and 2 Anesthetist.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: The candidate must possess Graduate/ Master/ PG Degree/ PG Diploma & Valid Registration compulsory.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for all posts, and age relaxation may be considered for Specialists by the Competent authority.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The remuneration is up to Rs. 2,00,000/- per month, negotiable, based on education qualification (PG Diploma/ Degree) in terms of incentive basis.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be attached to the application?
faq.answer: A copy of bio-data along with self attested copies of the Graduation and Post Graduation Degree and registration certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the posts are purely on contract basis for 6 months under the UT Plan; the contract may be extended based on performance appraisal or till the posts are filled up on a regular basis.

faq.question: Q10. Is T.A/D.A paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, no T.A / D.A or any other claim shall be paid for attending the interview.
